tools.name: hecate_tasks_list
tools.description: List all tasks. Optionally filter by agent_id, status, or priority. Returns an array of task objects sorted by most recently updated.

priority.description: Filter by priority (0-based, higher = more important)

tools.name: hecate_tasks_get
tools.description: Get a single task by ID, including its log entries.

tools.name: hecate_tasks_create
tools.description: Create a new task and assign it to an agent. Returns the created task.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to assign the task to

tools.name: hecate_tasks_update
tools.description: Update one or more fields on an existing task. Only provided fields are changed.

tools.name: hecate_tasks_delete
tools.description: Delete a task by ID. Also removes associated task logs.

tools.name: hecate_tasks_append_log
tools.description: Append a log entry to a task's activity log.

task_id.description: The task ID to append a log to

tools.name: hecate_tasks_bulk_update_status
tools.description: Update the status of multiple tasks at once. Useful for batch operations.

task_ids.description: Comma-separated list of task IDs to update

status.description: New status for all specified tasks

tools.name: hecate_agents_list
tools.description: List all agents with their status, model, role, and specialties.

status.description: Filter by status (ONLINE, OFFLINE, WORKING, etc.)

tools.name: hecate_agents_get
tools.description: Get detailed info for a single agent by ID, including XP data and provider config.

tools.name: hecate_agents_update
tools.description: Update agent fields such as name, codename, role, specialty, temperature, or status.

status.description: New status (ONLINE, OFFLINE, WORKING, THINKING, QUEUED, IN_SUMMIT, PAUSED)

tools.name: hecate_agents_set_status
tools.description: Quick shorthand to set an agent's status. Lighter than full update.

tools.name: hecate_agents_set_hero_image
tools.description: Set or update a hero image for an agent.

image_data.description: Image data URL or public URL

tools.name: hecate_agents_get_xp
tools.description: Get the XP, level, rank, and recent XP events for an agent.

event_limit.description: Max recent XP events to return

tools.name: hecate_notifications_list
tools.description: List recent notifications. Supports filtering by read/unread status and agent.

tools.name: hecate_notifications_create
tools.description: Create a new notification that will appear in the dashboard's notification panel.

action_url.description: URL to navigate to when clicked

tools.name: hecate_notifications_mark_read
tools.description: Mark a single notification as read.

tools.name: hecate_notifications_mark_all_read
tools.description: Mark all unread notifications as read.

tools.name: hecate_notifications_delete
tools.description: Delete a notification by ID.

tools.name: hecate_scheduler_list_events
tools.description: List scheduled events. Optionally filter by agent, date range, or status.

tools.name: hecate_scheduler_create_event
tools.description: Create a new scheduled event for an agent on a specific date.

tools.name: hecate_scheduler_update_event
tools.description: Update a scheduled event's details.

tools.name: hecate_scheduler_delete_event
tools.description: Delete a scheduled event.

tools.name: hecate_scheduler_move_event
tools.description: Reschedule an event to a new date and/or time.

tools.name: hecate_scheduler_execute_event
tools.description: Manually trigger a scheduled event now by setting its status to in_progress and updating last_run_at.

tools.name: hecate_workflows_list
tools.description: List all workflows with their status.

tools.name: hecate_workflows_get
tools.description: Get a full workflow definition including nodes, edges, and steps.

tools.name: hecate_workflows_create
tools.description: Create a new workflow definition.

nodes.description: JSON stringified array of node objects

edges.description: JSON stringified array of edge objects

steps.description: JSON stringified array of step objects

tools.name: hecate_workflows_update
tools.description: Update a workflow definition (name, nodes, edges, steps, status).

nodes.description: JSON stringified array of new nodes

edges.description: JSON stringified array of new edges

steps.description: JSON stringified array of new steps

tools.name: hecate_workflows_delete
tools.description: Delete a workflow and all its run history.

tools.name: hecate_workflows_trigger_run
tools.description: Execute a workflow by creating a new run. Returns the run ID for tracking.

global_variables.description: Initial global variables for the run

tools.name: hecate_workflows_list_runs
tools.description: List workflow run history, optionally filtered by workflow or status.

tools.name: hecate_workflows_get_run
tools.description: Get full details of a workflow run, including step results and global variables.

tools.name: hecate_chat_list_conversations
tools.description: List conversations. Optionally filter by agent, pinned/archived status, or mode.

tools.name: hecate_chat_get_messages
tools.description: Get messages for a conversation, ordered chronologically. Supports pagination.

tools.name: hecate_chat_send_message
tools.description: Post a new message to an existing conversation. Use role 'user' for operator messages or 'system' for automated instructions.

tools.name: hecate_chat_create_conversation
tools.description: Start a new conversation with an agent.

tools.name: hecate_chat_pin_conversation
tools.description: Pin or unpin a conversation.

pinned.description: True to pin, false to unpin

tools.name: hecate_chat_archive_conversation
tools.description: Archive or unarchive a conversation.

archived.description: True to archive, false to unarchive

tools.name: hecate_summit_list_sessions
tools.description: List all summit (multi-agent deliberation) sessions.

tools.name: hecate_summit_get_session
tools.description: Get a summit session with all its messages.

tools.name: hecate_summit_create_session
tools.description: Start a new multi-agent summit session.

participants.description: Comma-separated list of agent IDs to participate

tools.name: hecate_summit_add_message
tools.description: Post a message into an active summit session.

tools.name: hecate_summit_update_status
tools.description: Update a summit session's status (e.g. complete or archive it).

tools.name: hecate_projects_list
tools.description: List all projects.

tools.name: hecate_projects_get
tools.description: Get a project's details, including associated files.

tools.name: hecate_projects_create
tools.description: Create a new project with optional custom instructions.

custom_instructions.description: Custom instructions for agents in this project

tools.name: hecate_projects_update
tools.description: Update project details (name, description, instructions).

tools.name: hecate_projects_delete
tools.description: Delete a project and its associated files.

tools.name: hecate_knowledge_list_documents
tools.description: List knowledge documents. Optionally filter by agent or source type.

tools.name: hecate_knowledge_get_document
tools.description: Get full content of a knowledge document.

tools.name: hecate_knowledge_create_document
tools.description: Create a new knowledge document for an agent.

agent_id.description: Agent to associate the document with

tools.name: hecate_knowledge_delete_document
tools.description: Delete a knowledge document.

tools.name: hecate_knowledge_search
tools.description: Search knowledge fragments by content. Returns matching fragments ordered by importance.

tools.name: hecate_telemetry_get_summary
tools.description: Get aggregated telemetry summary — total tokens, cost, latency stats, broken down by agent and model.

since.description: ISO timestamp — only include data after this time

tools.name: hecate_telemetry_get_chart_data
tools.description: Get time-series telemetry data for charts. Groups by hour or day.

days.description: Number of days to look back

tools.name: hecate_telemetry_log_event
tools.description: Log a new telemetry event (API call record).

tools.name: hecate_audit_list
tools.description: List audit log entries. Supports filtering by agent, action type, or date range.

since.description: ISO timestamp — only entries after this time

tools.name: hecate_audit_create
tools.description: Write a new audit log entry for observability.

diff_payload.description: JSON diff or state change payload

tools.name: hecate_prompt_chunks_list
tools.description: List all reusable prompt chunks, optionally filtered by category.

tools.name: hecate_prompt_chunks_create
tools.description: Create a new reusable prompt chunk.

tools.name: hecate_prompt_chunks_update
tools.description: Update a prompt chunk's content, name, or category.

tools.name: hecate_prompt_chunks_delete
tools.description: Delete a prompt chunk.

tools.name: hecate_mcp_servers_list
tools.description: List all registered MCP servers with their status and assigned agents.

tools.name: hecate_mcp_servers_add
tools.description: Register a new MCP server.

tools.name: hecate_mcp_servers_update
tools.description: Update an MCP server's config (name, URL, transport, assigned agents).

tools.name: hecate_mcp_servers_delete
tools.description: Remove a registered MCP server.

tools.name: hecate_connections_list
tools.description: List all connection profiles with their status.

tools.name: hecate_connections_create
tools.description: Create a new connection profile for OpenClaw or Agent Zero.

tools.name: hecate_connections_activate
tools.description: Activate a connection profile (deactivates all others).

tools.name: hecate_connections_test
tools.description: Test a connection profile's connectivity. Updates the health status.

tools.name: hecate_gamification_get_overview
tools.description: Get a full gamification overview: all agents' XP/levels, daily missions, achievements, and streak data.

tools.name: hecate_gamification_award_xp
tools.description: Award XP to an agent. Automatically levels up if threshold is reached.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to award XP to

source_id.description: ID of the source entity (task ID, summit ID, etc.)

tools.name: hecate_gamification_get_missions
tools.description: Get today's daily missions and their progress.

date.description: Date to query (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today)

tools.name: hecate_gamification_update_mission_progress
tools.description: Increment progress on a mission type for today.

tools.name: hecate_gamification_get_streak
tools.description: Get the current operations streak and history.
